method: Each of Indonesia's 84,503 desa/kelurahan (BIG boundaries, generalised ~200 m) is assigned to the nearest documented location of an ethnic group (Ananta et al. 2014 list, located by Glottolog, the Kartapranata map or manual placement) on the same island group; desa with the same group are merged. On Sumba the nearest Glottolog language point is used instead. These are approximate homeland zones, not a census map: migrant, urban and mixed populations are not shown, and groups known only at island level are listed but not drawn.
